raw_text: Never commit secrets. No panics in library code. `make fmt` before committing; `make fmt lint test verify-sdk` before opening a PR. `make set-env`; `make test`; `make test-fast`; `make coverage`; `make lint`; `make tidy`; `make verify-sdk`; `go build ./...`; `make docs`; `make demo-data`. Minimum 80% coverage.
